guesses.breed: American Pit Bull Terrier / American Staffordshire Terrier mix
guesses.reason: The broad skull, wide muzzle, short smooth coat, and sturdy chest point to bully-breed ancestry.
The bluish-gray coat with tan points, white blaze, and folded drop ears resemble a blue tricolor Catahoula.
The soft drop ears, tricolor pattern, and long legs suggest some hound influence.

breed.appearance: Bruno is a young, leggy, large-breed puppy with a short, smooth tricolor coat: slate blue-gray on his back and head, rich tan points over his eyes, cheeks, and legs, and a white blaze running from his forehead down his muzzle to a white chest and front legs. He has soft, triangular drop ears that fold over at the tips with tan undersides, warm amber-brown eyes, a broad dark-gray nose, and a wide, slightly blocky muzzle. In the photo he sits on green grass wearing a bright turquoise collar, his head tilted curiously.
breed.fun_fact: Bully-breed mixes like Bruno are famous for their goofy, people-loving personalities and their wiggly full-body tail wags!
